info.title: Interfere API
info.description: Register builds, ingest telemetry, and inspect application issues. Build operations authenticate with a secret surface key; SDK ingestion uses a publishable surface key. Dashboard operations require a Clerk session, and investigation endpoints require workload identity. Authentication alternatives are listed on each operation. Retry only when the operation contract permits it, preserving the original idempotency key.

SignSourceMapsRequest.description: Initializes an upload session with the file inventory and declared sizes. Upload each file through the source-map endpoint using ordered byte offsets, then finalize the complete batch before the session expires.

CompleteSourceMapsRequest.description: Finalizes an upload session after all file chunks are durably accepted. Verifies the complete file inventory and schedules publication of the source-map manifest. Safe to retry.

TelemetryRequest.description: Timings and counters reported after a source-map upload.

IdentifySessionRequest.description: Request body for identifying the consumer associated with a session.

IdentifySource.description: Auth provider that surfaced this identification.

IdentifyTraits.description: Free-form key/value bag of user attributes attached when identifying a session.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying this request
